description: Local-first cinematic still archive for filmmakers. Search your frames by look, mood, technique or director with SigLIP semantic search; ingest video and URLs; build moodboards. Free desktop app for Win/Mac/Linux, Pro unlocks studio tools. Your library stays on your disk.
